metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to download 2 blog articles as PDFs to /home/user/Documents/Blog. Successfully created the Blog directory, used Ctrl+P print dialog, navigated save dialogs, saved both PDFs, and switched between Chrome tabs. Failed because PDF filenames included Chrome's default suffix (' _ Lil'Log') instead of just the article titles.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can use terminal to create directories (mkdir), navigate Chrome tabs, use Ctrl+P print dialog, interact with file save dialogs, switch between browser tabs
metadata.failure_analysis: Model saved PDFs with Chrome's default title format including ' _ Lil'Log' suffix. The evaluator script likely expected filenames matching just the article titles without the blog name suffix. Model did not rename files after saving.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original task into its simplest sub-task: creating the target directory. The model demonstrated this capability successfully in the trajectory.
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a directory at /home/user/Documents/Blog. Evaluator checks directory existence using shell test command via vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction requires creating a single folder 'Blog' at /home/user/Documents/Blog. Evaluator checks exactly this requirement.
Getter (vm_command_line) runs 'test -d /home/user/Documents/Blog && echo exists || echo missing' which correctly tests directory existence at the exact path.
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares getter output against expected value 'exists\n', which matches the shell echo output including trailing newline.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (directory creation) is fully verified by the evaluator.
Expected value 'exists\n' is semantically correct for the shell test command output.
